Terminos.metaDescription: Terms and conditions of use for YourAgencyToday.
Terminos.title: Terms and Conditions
Terminos.intro: These Terms and Conditions govern the use of YourAgencyToday's ("we", "the agency") website and travel-planning chat. By using the site, you accept these terms.
Terminos.whatWeOfferBody: Through our AI-powered chat we collect your trip details (destination, dates, budget, origin, and number of travelers) so one of our specialists can design a tailored itinerary proposal. The final proposal and its availability are subject to human confirmation.
Terminos.accountItem1: You are responsible for keeping your password private.
Terminos.accountItem2: The information you provide us must be truthful.
Terminos.accountItem3Prefix: You can request the deletion of your account and your data at any time through our
Terminos.liabilityBody: Proposed itineraries depend on the actual availability of external providers (airlines, hotels, transportation) at the time of booking. We do not guarantee prices or availability until a booking is explicitly confirmed by a specialist.
Terminos.changesBody: We may update these terms occasionally. Significant changes will be reflected on this same page.

Privacidad.metaDescription: How YourAgencyToday collects, uses, and protects your data.
Privacidad.title: Privacy Policy
Privacidad.intro: This policy explains what data we collect at YourAgencyToday, what we use it for, and what rights you have over it.
Privacidad.dataItem1: Your email and a password stored in encrypted form (or your Google account, if you choose that sign-in method).
Privacidad.dataItem2: The trip details you share in the chat: destination, origin, dates, budget, and number of travelers.
Privacidad.dataItem3: The content of the messages you send to our chat, which are processed by an external artificial intelligence provider to generate responses.
Privacidad.dataUseItem1: Designing and proposing a tailored travel itinerary.
Privacidad.dataUseItem2: Emailing you updates about the status of your request.
Privacidad.dataUseItem3: Keeping your conversation history linked to your account.
Privacidad.cookiesBody: We use a strictly necessary session cookie to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising tracking cookies.
Privacidad.rightsPrefix: You can ask us to access your data or delete it entirely by writing to us through our
